item.title: Lesson 79: “Let me recognize the problem so it can be solved.”
item.description: “Let me recognize the problem so it can be solved.” A problem cannot be solved if you do not know what it is. Even if it is really solved already, you will still have the problem because you cannot recognize that it has been solved.This is the situation of the world.The problem of separation, which is really the only problem, has already been solved.
